name: Ancient Statuette
summary: On Ashenvale's northwestern shore, Talen searches for the Ancient Statuette he recovered from Zoram's sunken ruins. The night elf effigy came from a city lost beneath the waves.

sections.title: A Relic in the Shallows
sections.body:
Off Ashenvale's northwestern shore, Zoram lies beneath the waves. The night elven city was lost in the Sundering ten thousand years ago. Recently, explorer Talen surveyed its ruins from a small craft, seeking relics from the past. Then naga attacked and drove him ashore.

Talen fled and left most of his belongings behind. Among them was the Ancient Statuette he had dredged from the ruins. It lies in the tideline sand near his scuttled skiff.

sections.title: Secrets of Zoram
sections.body: Talen calls the statuette his most prized possession. It was the reason he braved the monster-infested coast. He believes the effigy can help him decipher Zoram's architecture, history, and arcane secrets. All lie hidden beneath the surf of Zoram Strand.

faq.answer: The Ancient Statuette came from Zoram, a sunken night elven city off Ashenvale's northwestern coast.

faq.q: Who is looking for the statuette?
faq.answer: Night elf explorer Talen seeks the statuette. Naga attacked as he surveyed Zoram's submerged ruins by boat, and he left the relic on the beach as he fled.
Talen believes the statuette can help uncover Zoram's history and the secrets hidden in its ruins beneath the waves.

faq.q: Why are naga prowling around where it was found?
faq.answer: Naga have infested Zoram Strand's coastal waters and ruins. They attack surface dwellers who venture near the sunken remains of their submerged territory.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see the statuette as a fragment of Kaldorei civilization from before the Great Sundering, preserved under the sea for millennia.
As an Alliance member, you can help Talen document and reclaim night elven heritage from the naga encroaching along Ashenvale's coast.
